mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and temperatures around 62 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park, with a waning crescent moon visible in the sky.

In city news, please be aware that phase two of the Highway M construction project begins the week of September 7, which will result in traffic pattern shifts. Also, we are excited to announce that the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics tree sculpture has been installed at Century School Park.

Looking at your schedule, today features trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the downtown Farmer's Market kicks off in the morning, followed by pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee and more trivia opportunities in the evening.

Regarding local law enforcement, the Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they began an investigation that resulted in the arrest of a 34-year-old school staff member for a past offence.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The Verona location is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM, closing later tonight at 10:00 PM.
